For instance, we can ask whether the number of real roots of an expression of the form f1 · · · fm + 1 is polynomial in m and t. A bare bones version of this problem was pointed out by Arkadev Chattopadhyay (personal communication): taking m = 2, we can ask what is the maximum number of real roots of an expression of the form f1 f2 + 1. Expansion as a sum of monomials yields a O(t2 ) upper bound, but for all we know the true bound could be O(t).
